{"output": "def transform(grid):
    """Fill the interiors of rectangular outline glyphs by their size."""
    from collections import Counter

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            todo = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            component = []
            while todo:
                rr, cc = todo.pop()
                component.append((rr, cc))
                for nr, nc in ((rr-1, cc), (rr+1, cc), (rr, cc-1), (rr, cc+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and (nr, nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] == color:
                        seen.add((nr, nc))
                        todo.append((nr, nc))
            r0 = min(rr for rr, _ in component)
            r1 = max(rr for rr, _ in component)
            c0 = min(cc for _, cc in component)
            c1 = max(cc for _, cc in component)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            # Only fill a complete rectangular outline of this component color.
            if not (all(grid[r0][cc] == color and grid[r1][cc] == color for cc in range(c0, c1+1)) and
                    all(grid[rr][c0] == color and grid[rr][c1] == color for rr in range(r0, r1+1))):
                continue
            # Odd-sized outlined forms are colored 7; even-sized forms 2.
            fill = 7 if (r1-r0+1) % 2 == 1 else 2
            for rr in range(r0+1, r1):
                for cc in range(c0+1, c1):
                    if grid[rr][cc] == bg:
                        out[rr][cc] = fill
    return out
